news.text: the Rust Dogs came into Shale for the tithe
Shale paid the Dogs' tithe; Deputy Reese took a beating for arguing

decision.text: The Sink flooded in the spring the season closed on, with its relief still diverted to the Precinct. Ocho drowned at his clinic.

news.text: the spring came up the Sink's stair a hand higher than last year; the free doctor drowned holding the clinic door

decision.text: Leven burned in the night after you took the yard's money. Two people died on the ninth floor; the count went out of the tower under its keeper's arm.

news.text: a squatted tower in the Ring burned in the night, floor on floor; its count says two dead on the ninth
twenty debtors came up the Line to the Skirts on Concern paper, to dig Number Six past the Shift's picket

decision.text: While you were up the hill the strike at Number Six broke, and the Concern hanged Maren Okafor at Footgate, as the city wrote.

news.text: the strike at Number Six was broken; the Concern hanged the Shift's leader from the post at Footgate

decision.text: Nils Haber went up the hill on the Weighhouse's freight at two, asleep, with a tag on his wrist.

news.text: Joran Haber's boy went up on the freight at two; the Window wrote DISCHARGED IN SERVICE

decision.text: The guild's riders took West Halt's watch. Abe Mutasa was hanged at Kettle for Hamish Gorse; Chela Ortega was put off the Line.

news.text: the guild's riders broke West Halt's watch and hanged a boy at Kettle Cut for the guard

decision.text: Brodsky hanged Abe Mutasa at dawn at the end of Four Ways' platform, under the clock, for Hamish Gorse.

news.text: the stationmaster at Four Ways hanged a West Halt boy at dawn for the guard killed at Kettle

decision.text: The Concern's men came to West Halt at dawn with a paper and took the twelve from the water tower, Joaquin Ortega among them, for the Weighhouse.

news.text: the Concern took twelve debtors out of West Halt's water tower at dawn; somebody had told

decision.text: The Concern's through came off the rails on East Halt's east length at two in the morning. Willem Visser died in the cab.

news.text: the Concern's through came off the rails at East Halt in the night; its driver was killed; the halt is stripping the cars

decision.text: The Concern's through came off the rails on East Halt's east length at walking pace. Willem Visser jumped clear.

news.text: the Concern's through came off the rails at East Halt in the night at walking pace; the halt is stripping the cars
somebody came out of the Cistern at Knock, the first in living memory, and walked down to Shale
a man the Stilts' Book wrote drowned two years ago walked into Gull Stilts on the city road

decision.text: The guild hanged Yewande Coker from the tide post at dawn for the false light. Her girl was not asked about.

news.text: the guild hanged Gull Stilts' dive master from its tide post for wrecking its barges

decision.text: The guild hanged Ewan Tulloch, Lean's lamp-keeper, from the tide post at dawn for wrecks he did not cause.

news.text: the guild hanged the Rigs' old lamp-keeper from its tide post at Gull Stilts
the mackerel came into Gull Stilts' nets clean for the first time since the thaw

decision.text: After the night barge burned, Factor Thorne cast off the tide post and left the shore.

news.text: the guild's tide post cast off from Gull Stilts in the night; its factor has gone up the delta

decision.text: The Bond put Mirela Stan back in a box on the through east, returnable, at two in the morning. Espe watched it go.

news.text: the Concern's Bond at the Docks shipped a girl back east on the through as a returnable

decision.text: The Harbour Master's men cleared the Hulls at dawn for House Vane's bridge. Three hundred people carried what they had up the river stairs, and the cradle's cable was cut.

news.text: the guild cleared the old ships on the dry river at the Docks for a Crown bridge; three hundred people up the river stairs with their bedding

decision.text: Sawtown put Sigrun Brandvold on the Water at dawn, with one oar, for cutting marks. Her father watched from the shore and did not call to her.

news.text: Sawtown put the Ridge foreman's daughter on the Water for cutting marks at the boom

decision.text: The Bottoms' skid camp burned at two in the morning. They took the next barge down the river, all of them, Wayra Huaman and her baby with them.

news.text: the Bottoms' camp at Sawtown burned in the night and the crew went down the river

decision.text: The guild took the Patience for Magda Kowal's mooring at dawn and put its green on her bow.

news.text: the guild seized the Patience at Low Landing for her mooring
